name: Tree Lighting Ceremony at Dunedin City Hall
venue: Dunedin City Hall, Louden Avenue side
paras: The City of Dunedin holds its annual tree lighting ceremony on Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 5 PM at Dunedin City Hall. The city lists the event as free.
Residents gather in front of the building on the Louden Avenue side for the tree lighting presentation, with musical entertainment by the International Chorale and a special visit from Santa.
Dunedin Parks and Recreation presents the evening and answers questions at 727-812-4530.
tip: Gather on the Louden Avenue side of City Hall and arrive before 5 PM to see Santa's visit.

name: Dunedin Holiday Boat Parade and Tree Lighting at Edgewater Park
host: Dunedin Parks and Recreation with the Dunedin Boat Club
paras: Dunedin's Holiday Boat Parade returns on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 6 to 9 PM. Decorated and illuminated boats launch from Loggerhead Marker 1 Marina and travel the Intracoastal toward Dunedin Marina, leading up to the arrival of Santa.
The parade begins at 6 PM outside Loggerhead Marker 1 Marina, travels south to Union Street and returns north to finish at the Dunedin Marina, with boats arriving at about 7 PM.

Festivities in Edgewater Park include holiday music, a tree lighting ceremony, s'mores and concessions by Old Bay Cafe. Bleachers are set up in the marina parking lot, and the city suggests lawn chairs.
Other viewing areas include Weaver Park and spots along Bayshore Boulevard and Edgewater Drive, though boats stay in the channel there. Admission is free.
tip: Bring lawn chairs and arrive early, because bleacher and lawn space at the marina can fill up.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Dunedin Community Center
cost: $10 per person early bird through December 2; $15 per person on December 3 if space allows
paras: Dunedin Parks and Recreation invites families to Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 9 AM at the Dunedin Community Center, 1920 Pinehurst Road.
Children bring their wish list and join Santa for a pancake breakfast, crafts and entertainment.
The early bird fee is $10 per person on or before December 2, and the fee is $15 per person on December 3 if space allows. Tickets are sold through the city's online registration system.
tip: Buy tickets by December 2 for the lower early bird price.

name: Dunedin Holiday Parade and Old Fashioned Christmas
venue: Downtown Dunedin, Main Street and Douglas Avenue
address: Main Street and Douglas Avenue, Dunedin, FL 34698
when_note: Saturday, December 12, parade at 3:30 PM, festivities until 9 PM
paras: Dunedin's annual downtown holiday parade starts at 3:30 PM on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and travels along Douglas Avenue from Beltrees Street north to Skinner Boulevard. It features decorated floats, bands, performers and Santa Claus.

After the parade, Old Fashioned Christmas fills downtown through 9 PM with Clydesdale horse drawn carriage rides, snow slides, kids' crafts, old fashioned games, face painting, live music in Pioneer Park, street performers, snow flurries and s'mores.
Families can visit Santa Claus at the Dunedin History Museum to share their wishes and take photos.
The event is free to attend, with donations accepted at the activity areas. A free Jolley Trolley shuttle runs from 2:30 to 9:30 PM from the Mease Hospital overflow lot and Curtis Fundamental.
tip: Park at the Mease Hospital overflow lot or Curtis Fundamental and ride the free Jolley Trolley downtown.
